SELECT d_chnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d_chnl ON f.CHNL_K = d_chnl.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K

ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

       COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

  SELECT
    d_br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    d_dt.DT AS business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count

  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

)
SELECT * FROM txn
ORDER BY branch_name, business_date;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT
    CCY_CD1,
    STLM_AMT,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY STLM_AMT) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  CASE
    WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
      (SELECT STLM_AMT FROM transfers t2 WHERE t2.CCY_CD1 = t1.CCY_CD1 AND t2.rn = (cnt + 1)/2)
    ELSE
      (SELECT AVG(STLM_AMT) FROM transfers t2 WHERE t2.CCY_CD1 = t1.CCY_CD1 AND t2.rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2 + 1))
  END AS median_amount
FROM transfers t1
GROUP BY CCY_CD1, cnt;

  ) AS pct_growth
FROM txn_counts;

           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE interaction_type = 'negative') AS negative_ints,
           COUNT(*) AS total_ints
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC
    GROUP BY customer_id
), churn_score AS (
    SELECT d.customer_id,
           d.customer_name,
           rb.latest_balance,
           ic.negative_ints,

           (CASE WHEN rb.latest_balance < 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
           (ic.negative_ints * 2) +
           (ic.total_ints * 0.5) AS churn_risk
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
    LEFT JOIN recent_bal rb ON d.customer_id = rb.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN interaction_counts ic ON d.customer_id = ic.customer_id
)
